name: Beef Tongue
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free protein that's well-tolerated in SIBO. Rich in protein and nutrients without feeding bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Slow-cook or braise for 2-3 hours until tender
Peel outer skin after cooking when still warm
Season with low-FODMAP herbs like oregano, thyme, or rosemary
Slice thinly against the grain for best texture
nutritionalHighlights: High in complete protein (about 25g per serving)
Contains CoQ10 and other B vitamins
